text: Planning a trip can be just as exciting as the journey itself. I remember spending weeks researching flights and booking charming little hotels for my first solo adventure to Italy. Once I arrived, I was immediately immersed in a new culture—the pace of life was slower, and every corner seemed to hold a story. Tasting authentic pasta and gelato was a highlight, though I admit that ordering in a local trattoria was tricky. My limited Italian caused a few funny misunderstandings, but the friendly locals always helped me with a smile. Ultimately, those small challenges and delicious meals became the most vivid memories, reminding me that stepping out of your comfort zone is always worthwhile.
